capabilities: Record long voice memos with one tap on mobile or desktop
Transcribe recordings via OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, Groq, local Whisper server)
Append timestamped memo entries to today's daily note or the current note
Save audio files to a recordings folder in the vault
Trigger recording from iOS/Android shortcuts or NFC tags via obsidian://voice-note
extras: Transcription is optional; without a key users still get one-tap audio capture filed into daily notes. Audio only leaves the device if transcription is enabled. Unreviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest. Marketing site at quickvoicenote.com.
motivation: The author built it for people who think out loud away from a desk, such as students recapping lectures or founders noting ideas in the car.
problem: Capturing long spoken thoughts on mobile and getting them filed, transcribed and timestamped into the right note requires manual recording and copy-paste work.

relations.evidence: Bring your own key (OpenAI, Groq, or a local Whisper server)

requires.name: OpenAI, Groq, or local Whisper server key

summary: Voice memo recorder that saves long audio recordings to the vault and appends transcribed, timestamped entries to the daily note.
